speakers.description: Off-screen narrator, unseen, speaking in Chinese as a voiceover.

description.text: An empty railway platform stands with no travellers and no train at the platform edge. A wall-mounted exit sign is the sole visible lettering. The off-screen narrator's voice begins over the still station.
An empty railway platform with no travellers and no train at the platform edge.
The camera holds a static shot.

The exit sign is out of view as the same station continues. A train pulls away from the platform edge, moves across the scene and clears the station, leaving the track and platform empty. The same off-screen narrator's voice concludes.
A train pulls away from the platform edge and moves across the scene.
The train clears the station, leaving the track and platform empty.
The camera holds a static shot.
